title: Goals
description: Set a target, allocate investment products to it and see whether you are on track. Estimates use only the returns you enter, in today's money.

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.body: A goal is something you are saving toward: a car, an emergency fund, retirement. Allocate investment products to it to track your progress.

delete.title: Delete goal
delete.body: Delete "{{name}}" and its allocations? This cannot be undone.

form.name: Name
form.returnsHint: Real returns, above inflation: 6 means "inflation + 6%". They go from -50 to 100 and must run from pessimistic to optimistic.
form.dateMustBeFuture: The target date must be in the future.
form.returnsOrder: Returns must run from pessimistic to base to optimistic.

targetHelper.title: Suggest a target
targetHelper.averageExpense: Average monthly expense over the last {{months}} full months: {{amount}}
targetHelper.noExpenses: No expenses recorded yet, so there is no average to suggest from.
targetHelper.loadFailed: Could not load your average expense.
targetHelper.hint: Only fills the target field; nothing is stored.

allocation.description: Choose the investment products that fund this goal and the share of each. A product's shares across your active goals add up to at most 100%.
allocation.overCapacity: Only {{percent}}% of this product is available.
allocation.invalidPercentage: Enter a percentage above 0 and up to 100, with at most two decimals.
allocation.archivedNote: Restore the goal to change its allocation.

projection.captionWithSnapshot: Values in today's money. Latest snapshot: {{date}}.
projection.captionNoSnapshot: Values in today's money. No snapshot recorded yet.

history.caption: As of the current allocation: today's split applied to each product's past value, in today's money.

timeline.chartAria: Value of the goal: history as of its current allocation, then three projected scenarios, against the target
timeline.historyUnavailable: The progress history could not be loaded.
